findings.summary: Implementer report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only Nav.astro (11 insertions, no test files) and the repo has no wired-up test runner for apps/web at all — no playwright.config, no test script in package.json/apps/web/package.json, and no test files anywhere in git history (playwright is an unused root devDependency). The claim is unsubstantiated and appears false.
